summary: ONLİNE KUR full-stack verified. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed — /api/meta feedStatus=guncel, /api/prices returns 39 normalized items (25 gold + 14 currency) with correct Turkish number parsing (USD ~48.229 4-decimals, GA ~6858 2-decimals), /api/prices/{code}, /api/history/{code}?range=1G, JWT login (401 wrong pw, 200 right), admin/health & admin/products require Bearer, product margin draft→publish flow applies delta exactly (verified +0.5 TL on USD sell, +0.25 TL global on GBP), manual price mode (mode=manual manualBuy/manualSell) publishes with manual:true and exact values, global-margin PUT + publish reflects in /api/prices, anomalyThreshold and refreshInterval reported. Frontend: Market screen renders 39 rows with real data, Tümü/Altın/Döviz segmented filter (25/14) works, search filters live, favorite star adds USD to Favoriler tab, product detail opens with chart + range switcher (1G/1H/1A/3A/6A/1Y), calculator computes 10 USD → 482,29 ₺ correctly, alarms bottom-sheet creates & lists alarm, theme selector System/Light/Dark switches instantly, hidden admin entry navigates to /admin/login, login succeeds and dashboard shows Altınkaynak health (Çalışıyor, 185ms, 39 active) + live price table + Global Marj + Fiyatları Yayınla. No red screens, no broken flows.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely coming from a third-party or internal component; migrate any `pointerEvents='none'` prop to `style={{pointerEvents:'none'}}`. Non-blocking warning only.

action_items: Optional: migrate any `pointerEvents` prop usage to `style.pointerEvents` to silence React Native web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 618 lines — approaching size threshold; consider splitting into modules (poller, admin, prices, auth) if additional features are added.
MongoDB _id: server.py stores product_configs with _id=code (string) — response paths correctly map _id → code and don't leak ObjectId; admin_products and prices endpoints look clean.
compute_price handles manual mode fallback if manualBuy/manualSell missing — good defensive path.
Anomaly rejection compares to last cached sellDec — early first-run values cannot trigger rejection (correct behavior). ANOMALY_THRESHOLD_PCT=30 is exposed via /api/admin/health.
All admin endpoints correctly gated by Bearer JWT via `Depends(current_admin)`.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env — no hardcoded URLs found.
seed_data_creation: None. Test flow uses admin credentials seeded from backend/.env; each margin/manual test reverts its own draft and publishes to restore zero-margin baseline.
